title: Contribution to Determination of the Stress State in Unsaturated Soils
content: Determining the stress state of unsaturated soils is a fundamental step in addressing any geotechnical problem involving such soils. This paper presents a solution approach based on the simple assumption that the mix water and air bubbles within the soil pores behaves as a fluid with a density dependent on the degree of soil saturation with water—a premise that has been experimentally verified.
